idea-plugin.name: Niivue Viewer
idea-plugin.description:
Niivue Viewer opens medical imaging volume files directly in your JetBrains IDE.

Powered by Niivue — the same WebGL2 viewer used in the standalone web app and the VSCode extension. Double-click a supported file in the Project View and it opens in an editor tab with multiplanar slices (axial, coronal, sagittal) plus a 3D render in a 2×2 grid.

A toolbar lets you switch views, pan and zoom, tune the colormap and window, overlay a second volume (such as a segmentation mask or statistical map), inspect the NIfTI header, and step the crosshair or move through 4D timepoints.

Useful for researchers and developers working with neuroimaging or other 3D volume data — particularly when you already use Python tooling (nibabel, dipy, ANTs, FSL, nilearn) and want to inspect a volume without leaving the IDE.

Supported formats: NIfTI (.nii, .nii.gz), NRRD (.nrrd, .nhdr), FreeSurfer (.mgh, .mgz), MetaImage (.mha), MRtrix (.mif, .mif.gz, .mih), BrainVoyager (.v16, .vmr), NumPy (.npy, .npz).
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.1.1

  • New toolbar with View, Zoom, ColorScale, Overlay, Header and Navigation menus.
  • View: switch between axial, sagittal, coronal, 3D render and multiplanar; cycle through all five views; cycle the 3D clip plane; toggle interpolation, colorbar, radiological convention and crosshair; reset the view (rotation, zoom and pan).
  • Keyboard shortcuts: H/J/K/L (plus Shift+U/D) move the crosshair, 1-5 pick a view, V cycles views, C cycles the clip plane, R resets the view.
  • Overlay: load a second volume (e.g. a segmentation mask or statistical map) on top of the current image, then remove or replace it.
  • ColorScale: adjust colormap, min/max window, opacity and inversion per volume or overlay.
  • Header: view the full NIfTI header, or reset voxel size to 1 and origin to 0.
  • Navigation: step the crosshair along each anatomical axis and move through 4D timepoints.
  • New overlay display: matrix size and voxel size (top left).
  • New crosshair readout: mm coordinates and voxel intensity at the crosshair position (bottom left).
  • Fixed the plugin icon on JetBrains Marketplace (now a true vector SVG).

0.1.0

  • Initial release.
  • Supports 14 volume file formats: NIfTI, NRRD, FreeSurfer, MetaImage, MRtrix, BrainVoyager, and NumPy.
  • Open supported files in an editor tab via double-click from the Project View.
  • Multiplanar 2×2 grid layout: axial, coronal, sagittal slices plus an interactive 3D render.
  • HiDPI-aware rendering on Retina and high-DPI displays.
  • Embedded Niivue 0.68.2 (WebGL2). Works in IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, WebStorm, CLion and other JetBrains IDEs.
